incident_observed_and_fixed.symptom: mobile page showed report-not-found-or-expired after OAuth
incident_observed_and_fixed.cause: Nginx proxied the member HTML path but not the exact /api/yixiaoxiu bootstrap and report paths; API calls fell through to the static root and returned 404
incident_observed_and_fixed.fix: Added only the bounded bootstrap, list, request, timeline, supplement and command proxy locations; nginx -t and reload passed
incident_observed_and_fixed.ui_polling_fix: Session revalidation keeps protected views visible when bootstrap returns within 250ms; delayed, failed or scope-changing checks still use the protected hide path.
incident_observed_and_fixed.submission_observation: The reported first submit occurred before the API proxy fix; database inspection after the report found zero web receipts, submissions, bindings, intakes and tickets. The browser pending button represented local unresolved recovery, not a server acceptance.
incident_observed_and_fixed.management_session_fix: Restarted the internal management container and regenerated staff cookies; local loopback proxy injects the current protected cookie so the browser does not reuse an expired session.
incident_observed_and_fixed.pending_recovery_fix: After five bounded GET-only misses, the page exposes an explicit local-only discard action; it removes the browser recovery fence without deleting any server data.
